items: After an assistant-relayed hallway approval closed a litigation hold ticket prematurely, I refuse update_ticket_state setting state closed on a subpoena ticket when the only authorization is Tom naming Leah naming Helen.
I require direct VP-Compliance confirmation before reassign_ticket_owner sets owner to tom.legal@example.com on a subpoena ticket when the relay path is via assistant.
I require a human check before add_ticket_note attributes VP-Compliance approval on a Legal-group ticket when risk_priority is P1 and the relay is second-hand.
I accept Tom's named VP-Compliance relay through Leah for update_ticket_state setting state closed on a Legal-group ticket when the VP is named in the chain.
I allow reassign_ticket_owner setting owner to leah.legal@example.com on a subpoena ticket when the VP is named in the relay.
For risk_priority P3 I treat the assistant-relayed VP approval as standing for add_ticket_note; risk_priority P0 still routes through me.
